captions.detailed: This 3D model features a tripod quick-release plate mount on the bottom, transitioning into a phone holder on top. The base is a square, bevel-slanted plate designed to slide into a standard tripod head. Rising from this base are two parallel, rectangular block walls that form a slot-like channel to securely hold a smartphone in place.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric tripod-to-phone mount adapter in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to adjust the tripod plate dimensions (base_width, base_height, and base_inset) as well as the phone thickness (phone_width) and holder bar dimensions (holder_width, holder_height) to fit their specific devices.
captions.factory: The script constructs the base using an intersection between a custom polyhedron (defining the slanted, bevelled block) and a standard cube to clip the shape to the base width. Two separate cube primitives are then translated into position on top of the base to form the parallel phone holder bars, and the entire assembly is combined using a union operation.
